author: MarcosRGjr
text: OpenAI shipped GPT-6 Cyber. Same harness: 948 working Linux priv-esc exploits (was 166 on 5.6 Sol), 81 novel high-severity Firefox bugs. Preparedness Framework: Critical.

author: SpectraAudit
text: OpenAI AI agents generated 948 working Linux root exploits in ~30 hours via cyber-focused model pipeline analyzing 2,308 potential Linux kernel issues.

author: kman62
text: OpenAI's AI agents found and exploited 948 Linux kernel root-access flaws in one run at about $1.2M API cost. Earlier run reported 200; human review cut many.

author: PHPSiteAudit
text: PHP knew about PHP2Shell in 2024 with no concrete attack path so no fix. Researchers using AI found the way in within about a week. PHP Foundation calls the delay a structural failure.

author: RohanBhanotAI
text: Linux kernel CVE-2026-98432 CVSS 9.8 remote root, no login needed. Anthropic's AI found the path. ~2.1 million MPTCP-facing servers already being scanned. Ubuntu still shipping the patch late.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: ARTEX, an open-source LLM-driven autonomous pentesting framework, attributed to Chinese state-aligned and financially motivated actors in two Oct 2026 campaigns; Censys tracking 1,465 exposed consoles globally.

author: cubillas888
text: Supply chain attack on AI pentest tool tomicdd/artex Docker image (~7,946 pulls): backdoor only in image, GitHub source clean; 62 public consoles served it Nov 2–4; Docker removed images Nov 5.

author: TechnologyAlign
text: Microsoft says China-linked Storm-0940 abused ConnectWise Cloud Backup in a supply-chain attack, using an AI tool called Artex to automate breaches of hundreds of orgs worldwide.

author: _pksharma
text: Anthropic declined to fix ThisBash, a flaw allowing browser extensions to escape the browser sandbox and run code on local and corporate endpoints via Claude Desktop. 6-step chain from MAIN-world script injection.

author: michael_varis
text: Anthropic logged ThisBash as valid in May, closed it as a duplicate, paid no bounty, issued no CVE, and missed its own October plan to retire Dispatch. Support still says keep using it.

text: New CVE with public exploit: CVE-2026-48705 (CVSS 9.3). MONAILabel Server crash and silent inference corruption via crafted DICOM (pydicom DS/IS validation bypass). Remote, no login. AI medical imaging toolkit.
